verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims instant spend tracking against budgets (brex-docs-10) and real-time spend management (brex-docs-37), and lets users view spend in the mobile app (brex-docs-21). The transactions API exposes transaction data programmatically (brex-docs-4). However, nothing in the evidence documents a founder-facing view that breaks spend down by team, category, and merchant, and the real-time claims are marketing-level with no detail on latency. missing for 10: documented spend breakdowns by team/department, category, and merchant; concrete evidence of same-day transaction posting and visibility; independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time dashboards.
